source_contract.behavior: intersects timestamps across every market in the cluster before pair-specific inference
source_contract.driver: scripts/v7_local_factor_research.py builds one full-cluster panel and reuses it for every predeclared pair

interpretation: Adding an unrelated sparse market to a broad cluster can destroy every pair test that shares the cluster-wide complete-case panel, even when a predeclared pair and its predeclared controls retain a fully regular sample. This makes broader-universe aggression capable of reducing rather than increasing Local Factor statistical power.
required_successor_contract: Freeze each pair hypothesis and its admissible control set from contract metadata before price history, residuals, p-values, edge or PnL are inspected.
Build the regular panel per predeclared pair/control set rather than from the entire broad cluster.

Do not choose controls ex post from realized missingness unless the missingness mechanism is separately justified; unavailable predeclared controls should fail that hypothesis closed or use a predeclared fallback hierarchy.
Keep every predeclared pair in BY multiplicity with p=1 when its own predeclared panel is unestimable.
Preserve the conditional residual unit-root bootstrap, pair-excluded common factor, actual-fidelity n-step forecast, TTR buffer and price/PnL hedge units.
Only after this power/testability repair compare broader universes, shorter common samples, lower z and higher FDR on identical chronological data.
Promotion still requires empirical joint fill states, partial abort/unwind economics and positive fill-conditioned PnL under 1x/1.5x/2x costs.
